semantic_fixtures.covers: A successful optional ETB choice links the exact nontoken creature, publishes its current subtypes and P/T, preserves later +1/+1 counters, and labels changed public creature types.
Declining the optional trigger leaves the target in place and Duplicant as its printed 2/4 Shapeshifter.
A token target is rejected without consuming Duplicant's pending trigger, and a legal nontoken target can still resolve.
A card animated into a creature only on the battlefield is not a creature card in Exile and does not enable Duplicant's static ability.
Exiling the enchanted creature uses the normal zone-change path: its Aura goes to the graveyard and Equipment becomes unattached.
Accepting a declared commander's Exile-to-Command move drops the link and updates the public view; declining keeps the card linked without repeating the same-generation choice.
A target that leaves and returns before resolution is a new generation and is not exiled by the stale target.
The ETB trigger retains its event-time source generation, while a later battlefield incarnation cannot use the older linked exile record.
Clone entering as Duplicant creates an independent linked pair and does not replace the original Duplicant's linked characteristics.
The linked card's layer-7 CDA counts Duplicant's acquired layer-4 subtype without recursively evaluating the same characteristic pipeline.
A later layer-4 type-setting effect replaces Duplicant's earlier copied creature subtypes while its independent layer-7b copied base remains.
A later all-creature-types effect is represented by the engine characteristic and the existing public annotation label.
The copied base P/T part continues in layer 7b after a layer-6 effect removes abilities from Duplicant.
A linked CDA hand-count change with no battlefield mutation updates Duplicant P/T, invalidates the battlefield cache, and publishes the new public view.
